name: package_id
description: Unique package identifier, e.g. PKG-0032. Joins to bookings.package_id.

name: destination_id
description: The destination this package visits. Joins to destinations.destination_id, which carries the category.

name: name
description: Customer-facing package name, e.g. Aruba Classic Week.

name: description
description: 60–120 word customer-facing package description. Embedded in catalog_embeddings for semantic search.

name: base_price_usd
description: Current per-person price in US dollars, double occupancy, taxes and fees included.

name: previous_base_price_usd
description: The per-person price before the most recent price change. NULL for packages that have not been re-priced during the data window.

name: price_effective_date
description: Date the current base_price_usd took effect. Aug 1, 2026 for the two packages re-priced this summer.
